name: Astra Hybrid Smartwatch
description: Astra Hybrid Smartwatch combines a traditional watch face with a hidden digital display. Offers heart‑rate monitoring, sleep analysis, and Bluetooth call alerts. Stainless‑steel case with interchangeable straps. Battery provides up to 12 days of typical use.
shortDescription: Hybrid smart watch with discreet digital notifications and long battery life.

reviews.title: Sleek Design, Powerful Hybrid Features
reviews.comment: The Astra Hybrid Smartwatch looks great on my wrist with its classic analog face and subtle digital indicators. I love the seamless notifications for calls and messages without pulling out my phone. The fitness tracking, especially heart‑rate monitoring, feels accurate and motivates my daily workouts.

reviews.title: All-Day Battery and Accurate Tracking
reviews.comment: Battery life truly lives up to the claim—I've gone almost a week without charging, even with frequent use of GPS and heart‑rate monitoring. The watch is water‑resistant, so I can wear it while swimming and it still records my laps perfectly. Setup was straightforward, and the app provides clear sleep and activity summaries.

reviews.title: Disappointed by Inconsistent Syncing
reviews.comment: I keep running into sync problems; the watch often fails to update my steps and heart‑rate data in the companion app. The limited app integration makes it frustrating to get a complete picture of my health, and I expected more reliability for the price.
